title: Injecting Knowledge from Social Science Journals to Improve Indonesian Cultural Understanding by LLMs
reasoning: The paper aims to improve LLM's understanding of Indonesian culture. The dataset (IndoSoSci) is derived from social science journals covering various topics, including 'ethics' and 'religions. mythology. rationalism' as explicitly listed in Appendix G, 'Ontology of Journal Topics from Directory of Open Access Journals'. This demonstrates that the cultural knowledge injected into LLMs has a component related to faith and ethics.
